full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioners should not be enlarged on bail in Criminal Misc. Case No. 149 of 2010	arising out of G.R.Case No. 132 of 2009 corresponding to Jhaldhaka P.S. Case No. 06 dated 19.12.2009 under section 302/34 of the Penal Code, now pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nilphamari. 

 The learned advocate appearing for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are quite innocent and they have been implicated in this case falsely and they are victim of circumstances and since the case is sent for further investigation, there is no certainty as to when the trial will be commenced and as such the petitioners may be enlarged on bail. 

 In view of the submission of the learned advocate for the petitioners to the effect that the Investigation Officer could not conclude the further investigation, we are of the view that justice would be met if a time is fixed for concluding the further investigation of the case. 

 Accordingly the rule is disposed of with the direction that if within the 2(two) months from the date of receipt of the judgment the Investigation Officer failed to conclude the further investigation of the case, the concern Court is hereby directed to consider the bail of the petitioners.
